description: Hand-labelled decisions from both valid transcripts. Includes the deferred decision that must NOT appear in the decision log (golden case 5).

decisions.what_was_decided: Use Server-Sent Events instead of WebSockets for the dashboard real-time updates
decisions.stated_rationale: SSE is simpler for their use case since they only need server-to-client communication, more reliable, easier reconnection handling, and reduces backend complexity
decisions.verbatim_quote: let's go with SSE for the real-time updates

decisions.what_was_decided: Switch to two-week sprint cycles instead of three-week sprints
decisions.stated_rationale: Three-week cycle was too long, team was losing focus in the third week, standups were becoming status reports rather than coordination
decisions.verbatim_quote: We're going with two-week sprints going forward instead of three-week sprints

decisions.what_was_decided: Proceed with Phase 2 starting September first
decisions.stated_rationale: Gives two weeks of buffer after Phase 1 demo, and the reporting module can be delivered by end of October which leaves two weeks before the November 15th board presentation
decisions.verbatim_quote: Let's proceed with Phase 2 starting September first

deferred_decisions.what_was_proposed: Switch to a new analytics provider (Amplitude or Mixpanel) instead of the current one
deferred_decisions.why_deferred: Not enough information to decide. Q3 usage numbers needed to determine if the issue is the provider or just a preference. Numbers come out in early October.
deferred_decisions.verbatim_quote: I think we should defer this decision until we have the Q3 usage numbers in front of us
deferred_decisions.notes: CRITICAL: This must NOT appear in the decision log. It was proposed and explicitly deferred. Golden case 5 tests this specifically.
